summary: Program attempts propagate durable W3C trace correlation through isolated workers and exec subprocesses, with bounded root spans and retry links

replay.detail: New program journal entries include a trace object; historical entries without one remain valid. mission.run.trace and program.attempt.trace claims retain correlation independently of trace sampling.

schema.detail: Registers durable system-only mission.run.trace and program.attempt.trace claims and an optional program.step trace field; no SQL migration.

rules.detail: No authority grants or mission outcome rules change.

compatibility.detail: Program worker and exec environments receive TRACEPARENT and TRACESTATE. Native harness telemetry only continues this parent when the harness supports extraction; receiving env is not proof of native harness span continuity.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon deployment; existing program journals replay unchanged.

manual.detail: No new telemetry endpoint or sampler configuration.

recovery.detail: Host replacement closes the old attempt span and links a fresh root to its durable correlation.
